messages:
Alex: Quick sync — AuroraPay POC kickoff. Customer wants a 4-week pilot, production-like prompts, and a clear pass/fail check for the eval harness. We need: golden set, scoring rules, regression gates, and answers for the security questionnaire. Can we confirm scope and blockers by EOD?

Mira: @Alex noted. Proposed acceptance gates: 
- Latency P90 <= 220ms on their 8k prompt mix
- Throughput 200 rps sustained on reserved pool
- Accuracy: top-1 pass rate >= 88% on golden set (weighted by customer business categories)
- Regression: no more than 2% negative delta vs baseline on golden prompts
- Golden set: ~400 labelled examples across 5 intents, with 3 reference gold outputs each
- Scoring: combined BLEU+ROUGE for structured outputs, and exact-match + fuzzy for transactions

Jordan: Quick clarifications from AuroraPay:
- We'll provide 420 examples but can prioritize 150 as "must-pass" golden subset.
- Data is synthetic + redacted logs, OK to host on Redwood Dedicated.
- Security Q: they will want an answer on key rotation cadence and audit log retention.

Mira: Good — please upload the prioritized 150 to the shared drive (link in doc) and label by intent. I'll draft the scoring harness.

Sam: Notes from infra/ML side:
- We'll run quantized fp16 int8 candidate and compare. Need to record per-model token breakdown; include `--record-kv-cache` in the runner.
- For batch sizing: try dynamic batching with max batch 64, target latency <220ms.

Sam: Example scoring snippet (proto):
```python
def score(example, outputs):
    # weighted composite: intent_match * 0.6 + content_fuzzy * 0.4
    intent = exact_match(outputs['intent'], example['intent'])
    content = fuzzy_score(outputs['text'], example['gold_text'])
    return 0.6*intent + 0.4*content
```

Tess: Security checklist items we need to fill for AuroraPay:
- KMS integration: customer-managed keys? (yes/no + provider)
- Data residency: which regions are allowed
- Audit logs: retention days + export frequency
- Pen-test schedule and responsible owners
- SLA breach notification contacts

Jordan: For answers: KMS = customer-managed (AWS KMS), regions = us-east-1, eu-west-1, retention = 365 days, pen-test windows quarterlies.

Mira: On regression gates — propose CI block if any model variant shows >2% drop on the "must-pass" subset. Also run full golden set daily and post metrics to the console dashboard.

Alex: Pricing question from procurement: can we include a short note on incremental cost to run the dedicated pool for the 4-week POC? Need a ballpark by tomorrow.

Sam: I can run an estimate: baseline GPU-hours + payload token estimate. Quick calc: 4 weeks * 200 rps * avg 60 tokens/request -> ~2.9M tokens/day -> roughly X GPU-hours on g5dn-like instance. I'll produce a worksheet.

deploy-bot: [deploy] POC harness branch `aurorapay/poc-harness` built at sha abc123. E2E test stage queued. :rocket:

Mira: Uploading initial harness draft: https://redwood-internal.docs/aurorapay/poc-harness (contains scoring scripts, runner config, and acceptance checklist). Please comment.

Alex: Action items: 
- Jordan: upload prioritized 150 golden examples by EOD.
- Mira + Sam: finalize harness + regression CI by Wed.
- Tess: draft security answers and send to AuroraPay legal.
- Sam: pricing worksheet by tomorrow noon.

Jordan: Will do — aiming to upload by 5pm PT. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

Mira: I'll set up a 30m sync tomorrow after we have the dataset to walk through scoring decisions.

Alex: Thanks — I'll include these gates in the engagement doc and share with the AE/AM.
